rules: Only declared catalog feeds may be read automatically.
No authentication, private URLs, robots bypass, or arbitrary crawl is permitted.
Source text is retained only in provenance/processing storage; released Atlas records are original structured work.
NC, ND, unknown, and license-conflicting material is quarantined.
